interpretation.date_mentions: Date phrases are copied from the exact official XML table row. They are not normalized into effective dates or assigned to source eras; page labels, page-update dates, and filename tokens remain separate.
interpretation.coverage: This separately reconciles the 82 XML links selected from the current Downloads index and archived receipt URLs outside that selection. Receipt-only links do not expand the current-index denominator or establish the full MBS/PBS historical denominator, rights, field semantics, or admission.
interpretation.absence: An unresolved link is not evidence of source absence.
